name: Shucks Mordant
description: Two hundred years old, a literal animated skeleton in a white coat and stethoscope -- not a figure of speech, and the portrait already assigned to him (artwork/character-portraits/shucks-mordant.png) is drawn literal. Runs Intake Medicals on the combined campus personally (data/scene-briefs/episode-c1s1--intake-medicals.json): warm, unhurried, deadpan, asks a question and actually waits, gives instructions as single words ("Arm. Light. Breathe."), kind about things that are dangerous to know and honest that he's forbidden from saying more. One of the Directorate's four actual founders, present roughly two hundred years ago at the incident that produced the Watcher (ideas/story/blank-inheritance-master-timeline.md). Separately, decades later, he is named on Manako's revenge list as 'the institutional author of his ruin. Supervised the disgrace personally' (ideas/story/dossier-cicada.md #6) -- a fact his established table voice carries no trace of, deliberately; see designNotes below. His right hand is a detached familiar that flies on a kite, doesn't know it's supposed to be his, and comes and goes on its own unexplained business; his sleeve currently ends in a very convincing prosthetic.
designNotes:
Full history, voice notes and open questions live in ideas/story/bible/characters/shucks-mordant.md -- read that in full before writing any scene with him. THIS FILE FORMALIZES HIM AS A REAL ENTITY for the first time (data/npcs/ previously held only the three Directorate poles and six repair-crew-chief placeholders); it adds nothing his bible file doesn't already establish.

Tone, load-bearing: his founder status and revenge-list placement are LATER-CAMPAIGN information and must not leak backward into how he plays in Session One or any early scene -- he reads as untroubled, not as a man with a secret.

Proposed connection, 2026-09-12, NOT YET CONFIRMED BY INGRAM: while grounding data/locations/general-hospital.json (the fortress island's main hospital -- a separate, larger building from the campus's Intake Medicals hall he staffs personally), his title 'Chief Medical Officer' was read as plausibly extending to administrative oversight of the island's whole medical apparatus, hospital included, even though he is never there in person. That is a reasonable extrapolation of an already-settled title, not a new invention, but it directly touches his own bible file's open question 'what has he actually done for two hundred years besides staff intake medicals' without resolving it -- flagged there rather than settled here, and surfaced directly to Ingram for confirmation. If Ingram would rather the hospital answer to nobody in particular, or to someone else entirely, general-hospital.json's npcRefs is a one-line change.
status: established and voiced (Intake Medicals is built and playable); founder-era history and revenge-list placement are known but not yet played -- see his bible file's Open Questions for what's still undecided
